name: Double Mind
source:
Main character moves to a port town apartment left from his grandmother.  He has many cute girls as neighbors. But two personalities dwell in the protagonist. Will angel or devil in him take over?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公搬进了祖母留下的一套港口小镇公寓，周围住着许多可爱的姑娘。然而，主人公体内存在着两种人格。最终占据主导的，会是他心中的天使，还是恶魔？

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
